question:
Select the correctly spelt word to fill in the blank.

I really admire his ______ to fulfil his dream to join navy.
solution:
The correct answer is "**persistence**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The words **'parsistance**, **persistance**, and** parcistanse**' are **incorrectly** spelt, holding no appropriate meanings except '**persistence**'.
 
• Let us take a look at the meaning of the correctly spelt words:
 
• **Persistence**: the **trait** that enables someone to** carry on** with **something** they are trying to do, even when it is** challenging** or is opposed by others.
 
 
• Example: *She eventually got what she sought after being rewarded for her persistence.*
 
• *She has been quite persistent in her efforts.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the only correctly spelt word is: *Persistence*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Some of the **synonyms** of the correctly spelt word are:

 
• **Perseverance**
 
• Tenacity
 
• **Determination**
 
• Resolve
 
• Resolution
 
• **Resoluteness**
 
• Patience
 
• **Endurance**
